description: Short when trailing 24h return is high, long when low. In-sample edge exceeds the measured 11.006 bps round-trip cost (13.3 bps, 1.21x) and is significant (corr -0.043, 68 sigma), but the effect flips sign in 2023 (corr +0.055, ~40 sigma).
name: 24h momentum mean reversion
status_justification: Genuine, economically-sized (1.21x cost in-sample), multi-year effect (edge>cost in 2021/2023/2025). FAILS promotion Gate 2: significant sign flip in 2023 (corr +0.055, ~40 sigma). Not validated. Requires independent out-of-sample confirmation and regime classification of the 2023 exception.
